recognize_zh: 觸印片中芽細胞成片、細胞質深嗜鹼性且布滿空泡，外觀像 Burkitt 細胞；但 C-MYC 免疫染色與核型圖（約 66 條染色體的近三倍體）顯示這是具 Burkitt 樣形態的 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Touch imprint: sheets of medium-to-large blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous discrete cytoplasmic (and overlying) vacuoles, mimicking Burkitt cells
Blasts with fine chromatin and variable nucleoli; background of fat-like droplets
Biopsy: hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of blasts with irregular nuclear contours
IHC: nuclear C-MYC positivity in a large proportion of blasts
Karyotype: near-triploid complement with many chromosomes present in three copies
describe_en: Touch imprint of the bone marrow biopsy shows cohesive-appearing sheets of blasts with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm, fine chromatin and variably visible nucleoli, closely resembling Burkitt-type cells. The core biopsy is hypercellular and diffusely replaced by sheets of blasts with irregular nuclear contours. C-MYC immunostain shows nuclear positivity in the majority of neoplastic cells. G-banded karyotype demonstrates a near-triploid chromosome complement. Given TdT and CD10 expression with absent surface light chain (per case data), findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with near-triploidy, which is biologically related to hypodiploid B-ALL, despite Burkitt-like morphology.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are TdT-negative, CD34-negative mature B cells with surface light-chain restriction and MYC rearrangement, whereas these blasts are TdT-positive with near-triploidy.
Hyperdiploid B-ALL has 51–65 chromosomes with gains of X, 4, 6, 10, 14, 17, 18, 21 and a favorable prognosis, whereas near-triploidy (66–79) reflects doubled hypodiploid clone with TP53 mutation.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, blastoid
ddx.vs: Separated by TdT negativity, surface light-chain expression and FISH-confirmed MYC/BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with vacuolated blasts (e.g., monoblastic)
ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts are MPO or nonspecific esterase positive and lack CD19/CD10/PAX5.

stain: Wright-Giemsa imprint; H&E; IHC: C-MYC; G-banded karyotype
